comparison.objective: Install a rack rail versus align and clamp a floating guide rod, then prove carriage travel.
comparison.physical_skill: Spring-prong latching, telescoping rear registration and screw fastening versus fine rod parallelization, clamping and crank-driven functional verification.
comparison.success_condition: Four-point rack attachment with correct screw holes versus rod parallel within 0.12 degree and unstuck full out-and-back carriage travel.
comparison.reason: This is the closest alignment-and-locking analogue, but it tests guide parallelism and motion quality rather than staged rack-post engagement. Candidate alignment and force thresholds remain unspecified.
